t: The Erbauer hex shank flat wood drill bit set provides essential wood drilling capability for various professional and home renovation projects. This 8-piece set features high quality, precision-ground, and polished flat wood drill bits in common sizes from 12 to 32mm. Manufactured from durable heat-treated carbon steel, these wood drill bits are ideal for electricians installing cabling or joiners working with plywood, soft wood, hard wood and other similar materials. The ground cutting edge delivers faster and smoother drilling performance. A 1/4" (6.35mm) quick-change hex shank ensures easy bit changes and reduces slippage in drills with 10mm or larger chucks. The set is supplied in a robust storage case, compatible with other Erbauer PTA cases for efficient workshop organisation.
b: Ground Cutting Edge Delivers Faster Drilling
